source_method: Mainstream and independent UK retail broadband availability-checker expansion; provider primary HTML only; web-verified 2026-07-24; metadata-only
fixed_operations_global: No verified external-runner output; no duplicate retry
BT, EE, TalkTalk, Plusnet, Zen, Cuckoo, Lightspeed and Hey!Broadband retained
Generic product marketing never treated as property serviceability
Separate package eligibility from network presence
No future rollout state can become current availability
No runtime score changed without real runner evidence

sources.name: BT Broadband availability checker
sources.role: Postcode then address retail broadband availability and package precheck
sources.limitations: Postcode-only estimate is weaker than confirmed selected-address result

sources.name: EE Full Fibre broadband checker
sources.role: Postcode-based Full Fibre and fallback package availability precheck
sources.limitations: Product page is not a positive address result until checker resolves the property

sources.name: TalkTalk broadband availability checker
sources.role: Postcode-based Full Fibre/part-fibre package and expected-speed discovery
sources.limitations: Exact speed and packages are location-specific and must be confirmed at point of sale

sources.name: Plusnet Full Fibre postcode checker
sources.role: Postcode/address retail Full Fibre eligibility and package discovery
sources.limitations: If Full Fibre is unavailable the page may show other products; this must not be interpreted as FTTP availability

sources.name: Zen Full Fibre availability checker
sources.role: Postcode then address retail Full Fibre speed/orderability check
sources.limitations: Address-not-listed and unavailable states must fail closed

sources.name: Cuckoo Full Fibre postcode checker
sources.role: Postcode-driven retail Full Fibre availability and package precheck
sources.limitations: Register-interest/unavailable state is not live orderability

sources.name: Lightspeed Full Fibre availability checker
sources.role: Direct postcode availability precheck for Lightspeed network/services
sources.limitations: Only provider-specific footprint; a positive area hit still requires address/order confirmation

sources.name: Hey!Broadband postcode checker
sources.limitations: Coming-soon state must not be treated as orderable service
